name: Kashiwagi Shun
source:
Race: Human, European and Chinese heritage
Zodiac sign: Virgo
Weapon: Bladed fan and water magic

Shun is the medic on the Wing Sword. He is an obvious cross-dresser, with his lipstick, pink Chinese dress, and fishnet stalkings, speaking in the feminine language in a feminine tone. But his gracefulness hides his true strength when it comes to battle, as he is proficient in Chinese martial arts with a bladed fan, as well as water-elemental magic. He is friendly to the members of the ship, and in his free time he works on making medicines with herbs.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/seikai/seikai.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
